name: rosetta-twin-primes
code:
use default

let sieve_limit = 10_000_000
let composite = LIST(sieve_limit)

(0..sieve_limit) |> each(_ => composite.add(false))

for candidate in 2..sieve_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= sieve_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple < sieve_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

twin_pairs(bound: int) -> int =>
    (2..bound)
        |> filter(candidate => !composite[candidate])
        |> windows(2)
        |> filter(pair => pair[1] - pair[0] == 2)
        |> count()

powers_of_ten() -> Pipe[int] is
    let value mut = 10

    do
        yield value

        value = value * 10
    od
si

write_line("       under   twin prime pairs")

powers_of_ten()
    |> take(7)
    |> each(bound => write_line("{bound,12}{twin_pairs(bound),19}"))
